questionText: A vendor lends 74,000 rupees at a rate of 12% compound interest per annum, compounded annually. Find the interest for the 3rd year.
solution:
Interest of the 3rd year = (amount after 2 years) × rate
Amount after 2 years = 74000
×
(1.12)² = 74000
×
1.2544 = 92825.60
Interest = 92825.60
×
12 / 100 = 11139.072
Interest for the 3rd year ≈ 11139.07
Ans: (3) 11139.07
